sections.Root cause: State was written to a volatile cache.
sections.Failed approaches: The investigation initially focused on the OS update.
sections.Fix: Moved state to the durable storage adapter.
sections.Verification: Restarted twice and reran the persistence regression test.
sections.Reusable lesson: Verify the persistence boundary before blaming the runtime.

candidate.title: Verify storage durability before broad runtime diagnosis

sections.Observation: Volatile storage can mimic an OS regression.
sections.Counterexamples / uncertainty: Migration and serialization failures can produce similar symptoms.
